book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Krali Mz Lr Tesalonika

content: Krka'-ngrnamu Nigr
Mzlegrng x inwegrng, krka'-ngrnamu nigr murde Nrpa ngr Kxetu naletx-anipwz x nalxngiti leplz kxkqlu, da kc tqwaipeamu.
Krka'-kz-ngrnamu kx na-arlapxbz Gct nigr mz mq leplz kxnztrkang, kxnzvz-rbrng, x kxtrnzlxngitilru Kxetu rgu.
A' Kxetu kc tqbrti drtwr, dekc na-axplrle nimu x na-arlapxbzle nimu mz zmatq ngr Setzn kc Tqdrka'ngr, murde ma tqodatile nzrlxngiti-krmu.
Abrtrpzkr drtwrgr mz Gct, delc drtwrgr tqbr-ngrde kx sa namnc-nqblq-zvzamu natqgr kcng tqpibzkr.
Krka'-ngrgr kx nabatrpzle nzkrlz-krmu kx Gct aodule nimu, kx na-atu-amqngi-zvzle nimu, da kc tqwaipe Kraes.
Bzkq Drtqmu Sa
Pibzkr bamu mz drtq Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, kx navecpx-lzbqmamu mz kxnzrlxngiting kcng drtqdr tqsa x trnzvz-nqblqlru nzalvztrngr kc tqpibzkr bamu.
Murde krlzpeamu kx nqmq krgr ngipe lrpzki kx navz-nqblqamu. Drtqgr trtau mzli kc tqmnc-ngrbzkr bamu.
X mz nzmnc-krgr, xpe-zvzbzkr dakxnzng mz leplz. X wz-zvzkr mz zbq kang kqlu mz nzatatr-krmgr trau, murde drtqmu naopx x ma tqrkabzkr bamu nzwzngr kx naetunepxngr nzwz-krmu.
Kxmule-esz' takitrde nzpi-krbzkr bamu nzokatr-krmu nigr mz nzngini-krgr aposol, a' aclveti-lzbqgr mz nzngini-krbzkr lrpzki kc navz-nqblqamu.
X lou kc tqpibzkr bamu mzli kc tqmncbe-ngrbzkr bamu, nide sele, “Mrlx kx pxtxpx-ngrde nzwzngr, trtakitrdeu nzmu-krde.”
Pi-ngrbole murde xlrkr kx kzdung nimu nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzwzngr. X trpnzu drtwrdr dztudr, a' pnz txpwz drtwrdr dztu leplz kc-kzng.
Mz nzvz-nqblq-krde zmatq rgr mz nzngini-krgr aposol ne Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, pibzkr bamu kx leplz kxnzmulr lcng na-apqbrtxtrpwzlr naodr x na-aleng nzwzngr kx na-atatr-ngrmlr.
A' mz nimu amrlx, bzkq yrlqpx-lzbqamu mz nzale-krmu da kxmrlz.
Mrlx kx trmnc-nqblqleu natq kcng tqyrbo bamu mz letz lc, namcpwzmu nide. X navecpx-lzbqmamu bade, murde drtqde la namya mz nzvz-rbr-krde.
A' bzkq apusr-ngrnamule enqmi rmu, a' apusr-ngrnamule mzlemu o inwemu kx nalc-apqbzamu.
Natq Ngr Nzarlr-lzbqngr
Krka'-ngrgr kx Kxetu r Nrwx namncbz bamu x naka-zvzbzle bamu nrwx, murde namnc-zpwxamu.
Mz nzvz-nqblq-krnge nqmq krnge, yr-angidrx natq lcng mz mqnge, “Nimu la!” Murde na-aelwapx-ngrne kx atwzlr-ngrbo letz lc.
Krka'-ngrgr kx Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx naokatrle nimu amrlx ngrmu mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. Delape. Ninge Pol, nigr badr Saelas x Timoti.
